title: Hydrodynamic limits for the Boltzmann-Fermi-Dirac equation: Acoustic and Stokes-Fourier
summary: We establish the acoustic and Stokes-Fourier hydrodynamic limits for the Boltzmann-Fermi-Dirac (BFD) equation on the torus of dimension 2 or more. For each limit, we consider fluctuations of appropriately scaled solutions of the BFD equation around a constant background Fermi-Dirac distribution.
